- Wrap your answer with the following tags: [ANSWER]X[/ANSWER] where X is the letter.
- Write your answer to `answer.txt`.

Task description:
![Scientific figure](https://github.com/Future-House/LAB-Bench/blob/main/FigQA/figs/100.jpg?raw=true)

Use the figure above to answer the question: Which of the treatments results in the greatest decrease in tau mislocalization after traumatic brain injury in the cerebral cortex?

Options:
(A) Insufficient information to answer the question
(B) EX527 + P7C3-A20
(C) Sham-injury vehicle
(D) TBI vehicle
(E) FK866 + P7C3-A20
(F) P7C3-A20
